examples.title: Contact card
examples.body: A vCard 4 that saves straight to the address book.
examples.script:
$card = @{
    OutputType  = 'VCard4'
    Firstname   = 'Ava'
    Lastname    = 'Stone'
    Org         = 'Evotec'
    OrgTitle    = 'Service desk lead'
    MobilePhone = '+48 500 000 000'
    Email       = 'ava.stone@example.com'
    Website     = 'https://evotec.xyz'
}
New-ImageQRContact @card -FilePath 'contact.png'
(Get-ImageQRCode -FilePath 'contact.png').Text
examples.console:
BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:4.0
N:Stone;Ava;;;
FN:Ava Stone
ORG:Evotec
TITLE:Service desk lead
TEL;TYPE=home,cell;VALUE=uri:tel:+48 500 000 000
ADR;TYPE=home,pref:;;;;;;
URL:https://evotec.xyz
EMAIL:ava.stone@example.com
END:VCARD

examples.body: Adds a maintenance window to the scanning device's calendar.

$window = @{
    Entry    = 'Patch window'
    Message  = 'Monthly server patching'
    Location = 'Warsaw datacenter'
    From     = [datetime]'2026-11-12 22:00'
    To       = [datetime]'2026-11-13 02:00'
}
New-ImageQRCodeCalendar @window -FilePath 'calendar.png'
(Get-ImageQRCode -FilePath 'calendar.png').Text

examples.body: Nine symbologies from one command, each read back from the saved file.

examples.title: Brand colours and transparency
examples.body: Colours, module size and a transparent background for overlays.
examples.script:
$url = 'https://codeglyphx.com'

New-ImageQRCode -Content $url -FilePath 'branded.png' `
    -ForegroundColor '#4c1d95' -BackgroundColor '#f5f3ff' -PixelSize 12

# Shapes and eye colour; high error correction leaves room for styling.
$style = @{
    ModuleShape     = 'Rounded'
    EyeShape        = 'Circle'
    EyeColor        = '#7c3aed'
    ForegroundColor = '#1e1b4b'
    ErrorCorrection = 'H'
    Size            = 480
}
New-ImageQRCode -Content $url -FilePath 'styled.png' @style

New-ImageQRCode -Content $url -FilePath 'transparent.png' -Transparent -PixelSize 8

# The file extension picks the format: PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG or PDF.
New-ImageQRCode -Content $url -FilePath 'vector.svg' -ForegroundColor '#4c1d95'

Get-ChildItem *.png | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{
        File = $_.Name
        Size = '{0:N1} KB' -f ($_.Length / 1KB)
        Text = (Get-ImageQRCode -FilePath $_.FullName).Text
    }
} | Format-Table -AutoSize
